dedupe_keys.name: co udlabs wp7 development of mechanistic models to simulate deterioration of drainage assets

description: Tait, Simon at University of Sheffield publishes experimental pipe-joint articulation, loading and leakage results through Co-UDlabs. Complementary full-scale tests study infiltration/exfiltration associated with displaced joints, internal displacement measurements and buried-pipe loading. The accompanying report distinguishes pipe materials, damaged seals and soil burial; these related components remain one joint-experiment bundle. Coverage is University of Sheffield and IKT facilities in the United Kingdom and Germany; test dates are not stated. Zenodo provides an XLSX results workbook and a PDF storage report with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is source findings do not establish general deterioration rates, and the role of joint condition differs from external angular displacement. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
